## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-verify-gha-runner.sh exists and is executable
- [ ] Test case: gh auth success + empty run list → script exits 0 and calls ticket comment
- [ ] Test case: gh auth failure → script exits 1 without calling ticket comment
- [ ] Test case: gh run list failure (non-auth) → script exits 1
- [ ] All tests use mock_gh() to stub CLI calls (no real GitHub API calls)
- [ ] Test file is self-contained and passes before verify-gha-runner.sh exists (RED)
